content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who manages tasks","i_want":"to download the task report as an Excel file","so_that":"I can review or share the tasks I see in the report outside the application","business_description":"The task report page lets users download its data as an Excel file. The exported file contains only the rows that match the currently applied filters, in the currently applied sort order. Each file name includes the time the file was generated. The file uses clear column headers and one date format for all date columns. The team has not yet decided whether the file is generated in the frontend or the backend.","business_value":"Users can take the filtered and sorted task data out of the application for offline review and sharing, without retyping it.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The task report page shows 12 tasks with no filters applied","when":"The user selects the Excel export action","then":"An Excel file is downloaded that contains 12 data rows, one per task"},{"given":"The report has the Status filter set to Open and is sorted by Due Date ascending","when":"The user selects the Excel export action","then":"The downloaded file contains only tasks with status Open, in ascending Due Date order"},{"given":"The user exports the report at a given moment","when":"The file is downloaded","then":"The file name contains the timestamp of the moment the file was generated"},{"given":"The applied filters match no tasks","when":"The user selects the Excel export action","then":"No Excel file is downloaded and a message is shown to the user explaining that there is no data to export"},{"given":"A report with at least one task is exported","when":"The user opens the downloaded Excel file","then":"The first row contains clear column headers and every date column uses the same date format"}],"edge_cases":["The applied filters match no tasks: the export produces no file and shows a no-data message. The PRD does not define the message wording, and whether a file is still produced in this case is an open question.","The report has a single matching task: the file contains one data row.","The report is changed after it is loaded but before export: the export uses the filters and sort order applied at the moment the user selects the export action.","The generation location (frontend or backend) is not yet decided, so the export data source and the place where the file is built depend on that decision."],"dependencies":["US-view-task-report","US-filter-search-sort-report"],"definition_of_done":["The Excel export action is available on the task report page.","The exported file contains exactly the rows matching the applied filters, in the applied sort order.","The file name contains the generation timestamp.","Column headers are clear and all date columns use one date format.","No file is downloaded when there is no data, and the user sees a message.","Automated tests cover the export with and without filters, the file name, the headers, the date format and the no-data case.","The generation location decision is documented with rationale and trade-offs."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"excel-export-generation-decision","title":"[BE] Decide and document where the Excel file is generated for the task report","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Decide whether the Excel file is generated in the frontend or the backend, and record the decision, its rationale and its trade-offs. The decision sets the scope of the Excel generation task and of the export action task.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-3a63e0ce"],"derived_reason":"decision_spike","is_spike":true,"definition_of_done":["A decision document states whether the Excel file is generated in the frontend or the backend.","The document gives the rationale and the trade-offs of the chosen option and of the rejected option.","The document states which data the generator receives and which part of the export is owned by each track.","The document is shared with the frontend and backend developers of this story."]},{"key_slug":"task-report-excel-generator","title":"[BE] Generate the filtered and sorted task report as a timestamped Excel file","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Build the Excel file generation for the task report, using the rows that match the applied filters in the applied sort order. The file has clear column headers, one consistent date format for all date columns, and a file name that includes the generation timestamp. This task applies when the decision task places generation on the backend. If the decision places generation in the frontend, the generation work is done in the frontend under the decision and this task is replaced by that work.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-09e9d163","R-d22b9b6a","R-fad183b1"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Generated files contain only the rows matching the filters and keep the sort order.","Column headers are clear and every date column uses one date format.","The file name includes the timestamp of generation.","A request with no matching rows returns no file and a clear error response instead of an empty file.","Unit tests cover filtered rows, sort order, headers, date format and file name."]},{"key_slug":"report-excel-download-action","title":"[FE] Add Excel export action that downloads the filtered and sorted task report","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add an Excel export action to the task report page. The wording of the message is not specified in the PRD and must be confirmed by the product owner.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-437992f1"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["No file is downloaded when there are no matching tasks.","A message tells the user there is no data to export.","The message wording is confirmed by the product owner.","Tests cover the no-data case."]},{"key_slug":"excel-export-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for the task report Excel export","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Create the end-to-end and integration tests for the task report Excel export, covering filtered rows, sort order, file name timestamp, headers, date format and the no-data case.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-52360b76","R-09e9d163","R-d22b9b6a","R-437992f1","R-fad183b1"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover an export with no filters and 12 tasks, producing 12 data rows.","Tests cover an export with the Status filter set to Open and a Due Date ascending sort.","Tests check the file name contains the generation timestamp.","Tests check the headers and the date format in the opened file.","Tests check that no file is downloaded and a message is shown when no tasks match.","The suite runs in the continuous integration pipeline."]}]}
